description: Gravita India Limited manufactures and recycles lead metal, lead products, aluminium alloys, and plastic granules in India and internationally. It operates through Lead Processing, Aluminium Processing, Turn-Key Solutions, Plastic Manufacturing, and Copper Alloys and Strips Processing segments. The company engages in smelting of lead battery scrap/lead concentrate to produce secondary lead metal, such as pure lead, specific lead alloy, lead oxides, and lead sheets, lead powder, lead shot, etc.; trading of taint tabor and tense aluminium scraps; and manufacturing of alloy from melting of aluminium scrap. It also offers recycled plastic granules, including ABS regrind, PPCP granules, and HDPE granules; recycles tyre products, such as tyre pyrolysis oil, rubber crumbs, and carbon black and char; copper alloy ingots, billets and cast forms, rods and bars, sheets and strips, and cast or engineered components; and turnkey solutions for recycling processes and solutions. In addition, the company provides consultancy services for recycling operations; extended producer responsibility recycler and compliance services; and lithium battery recycling services, as well as procures various scrap material, such as lead acid batteries, lead scrap, aluminium scrap, plastic scrap, and rubber scrap. The company also exports its products. Gravita India Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Jaipur, India.
